mapper.sql: SELECT d.id AS document_id, v.id AS version_id, d.space_id, d.status AS document_status, s.archived AS space_archived, v.publication_protocol, v.publication_evidence, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_document_review r WHERE r.version_id = v.id AND r.state = 'IN_REVIEW') AS review_in_progress FROM kb_document_version v JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id JOIN kb_space s ON s.id = d.space_id WHERE d.id = #{documentId} AND v.id = #{versionId} AND d.status <> 'deleted'
mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS document_id, v.id AS version_id, n.text, n.base_version_id, b.version_no AS base_version_no, COALESCE(n.note_version, 0) AS note_version, COALESCE(n.corrected, FALSE) AS corrected, COALESCE(n.created_after_visible, FALSE) AS created_after_visible, n.updated_at FROM kb_document_version v JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id LEFT JOIN kb_document_change_note n ON n.version_id = v.id AND n.doc_id = d.id LEFT JOIN kb_document_version b ON b.id = n.base_version_id AND b.doc_id = d.id WHERE d.id = #{documentId} AND v.id = #{versionId} AND d.status <> 'deleted'

SELECT b.id AS version_id, b.version_no FROM kb_document_version b JOIN kb_document_version v ON v.doc_id = b.doc_id WHERE v.doc_id = #{documentId} AND v.id = #{versionId} AND b.version_no < v.version_no AND b.publication_evidence IN ('PUBLISHED', 'OBSERVED_CURRENT') ORDER BY b.version_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document_change_note (version_id, doc_id, text, base_version_id, note_version, corrected, created_after_visible) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{documentId}, #{text}, #{baseVersionId}, #{noteVersion}, #{corrected}, #{createdAfterVisible}) ON CONFLICT (version_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO kb_document_change_note_history (version_id, doc_id, text_before, text_after, base_before, base_after, visible_to_readers, reason) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{documentId}, #{textBefore}, #{textAfter}, #{baseBefore}, #{baseAfter}, #{visibleToReaders}, #{reason})
